script: 一个女孩在雨夜走在校园里。她收到一条陌生短信，停下来查看。短信让她露出惊讶的表情。她望向远处，然后快步离开。

shots.summary: The young woman walks alone under a clear umbrella along a wet campus pathway on a rainy night.
shots.camera: Medium tracking shot moving backward, eye level, slow smooth motion
shots.subtitle: It is freezing tonight.

shots.summary: Macro view of her smartphone screen buzzing with a sinister message from an unknown number.
shots.camera: Macro close-up, static camera with shallow focus racked to phone screen
shots.subtitle: Wait, who sent this?

shots.summary: Close-up of her face as cold realization and pure shock take over her expression.
shots.camera: Close-up, slow subtle push-in, low angle looking slightly up
shots.subtitle: How could anyone know?

shots.summary: She peers into the foggy distance, then abruptly turns and rushes away into the rain.
shots.camera: Medium-wide shot, slight pan and smooth lateral tracking following her sudden departure

dialogue.speaker: Girl
dialogue.line: I need to get out of here right now.

shots.subtitle: I need to get out of here right now.

quality.evidence: Optimized 第3镜保留惊讶、望远、转身快走；四句对白按原序保留。Baseline 结尾改为空景。
Optimized 恢复可见人物行动；但收到短信后明确停下查看仍主要靠特写暗示。
Optimized 人物仍是结尾主体；合并为8秒连续镜头，表情特写转广景及动作编排比D更紧凑，未验证实际视频。
人物、校园、雨伞与手机保持一致；手部道具调度仍未细化。
Optimized 为4/4/8秒、总16秒，允许值与求和正确；13个英文单词口播估算能容纳，但动作节奏仍待视频验证。
Optimized 仍要求对白接近片尾结束，同时绝对静音且保留雨声/脚步/城市hum字段；声轨时段与尾部留白要求冲突。
两稿均沿用D添加的具体短信、四句对白及恐慌解读；原剧本未给这些内容。
